product.title: POLYGON - Alpine Mountain - Nature Biome
product.body_html:
Synty® Studios Presents: POLYGON - Alpine Mountain - Nature Biome

Explore this canvas of vibrant hues, from the rich greens of pine trees to the fiery reds, all harmoniously set against the backdrop of snow-capped summits.

POLYGON - Alpine Mountain captures the essence of serenity in every season. This 3D low poly asset pack contains not only various prefabs, environment materials and textures but also a detailed demo scene, allowing you to add to or build out diverse landscapes in your video game.

This game dev asset pack showcases the captivating beauty that transcends the ordinary. Uncover the secrets hidden in the spaces between the trees and let the alpine mountain unfold before your very eyes.

Nature Biomes Packs: 

Bundles:

  • POLYGON - Nature Biomes - Season One
  • POLYGON - Nature Biomes - Season Two

Individual Asset Packs: 

  • POLYGON - Arid Desert - Nature Biome
  • POLYGON - Enchanted Forest - Nature Biome

 *Contents may vary between engines. 

📦 Pack Content

A comprehensive demo scene illustrating how to make the most out of the assets contained in this pack!

◼ Environment (x86) ◼
Background trees, branches, bushes, mounds and ground cover, ice sheets, lake, moss lumps, mountain ranges, pine trees, rocks and cliffs, snow mounds, stalactites

◼ Props (x23) ◼
Backpack, bench, cabin, campfire, canoe and oar, chairs, fish rack, fishing rod and stand, fossil, ice auger and axe, fishing hut, jetty, lookout, sleeping bags and tent, thermos, wood piles

◼ FX (x16) ◼
Auroras, butterflies, dust spots, fire, fog, hawks, leaves, petals, smoke, snow, snow dust, sunray, water drip, wind streaks

🤖 Technical Info

◼ Compatibility ◼

  • Compatible with Unreal 5.3+
  • Compatible with Unity 2022.3+
    - Supports URP and Built-in
    - Characters set up with Mecanim (no animations included)

◼ File Formats ◼

  • Unreal 5.3 project
  • Unity 2022.3 package
  • FBX Source Files
